target_max_hp_damage_percent.statement: Each hit adds the listed percentage of the target's maximum hitpoints to its base impact.

historical_unavailable_profiles.reason: No reproducible historical v18.200.9 Monolith projectile profile has been curated. It is not used to assert current TH18 speed, launch or impact timing.

test_evidence: cocsim_monolith_tests: Monolith L1 applies its sourced base impact plus 11% of the Dragon's immutable maximum hitpoints at launch; the serialized projectile, snapshot restoration and command replay retain the identical 434 damage result.
